moments.author: Dario Amodei
moments.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models… rogue AI agents could take over the internet in as little as six months.
moments.why: A rare public call by a top AI CEO to slow development over existential safety, striking a nerve across tech and culture.

moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.
moments.why: A stark doomsday warning from an insider that catalyzed an AI panic in Congress and media.

moments.author: SportsCenter (retweet of ESPN Insights)
moments.quote: Malachi Toney broke Miami's single‑game receiving yards record set by Eddie Brown in 1984… in less than 3 quarters.
moments.why: An explosive sports highlight that’s got fans raving about a record‑shattering rookie performance.

moments.author: ESPN Insights
moments.quote: The Guardians' Brayan Rocchio … 6th player in MLB history to hit a grand slam and a walk‑off HR in the same game.
moments.why: A rare MLB feat that’s sparking baseball conversation and highlights across social feeds.

moments.author: Anthropic (official account)
moments.quote: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date… covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence ops…
moments.why: An unexpected transparency move from an AI lab, sharing misuse cases amid a wave of safety scrutiny.
